author: Christian Jones
title: Dragons scorch Birmingham Legion; keep undefeated start alive - NewsBreak
text:
By Christian Jones ,
1 hours ago DOTHAN, Ala. ( WDHN )—Despite a surprise rain shower in the halftime break, the weather and the opposing team proved that even those combined efforts couldn’t put out the Dragons’ fire.
Dothan United welcomed Birmingham Legion FC 2 to Rip Hewes Stadium for a league matchup, with the Dragons putting their 4-0 start to the season on the line.
Kicking things off, the Iron City squad came out of the gates uber-aggressively, getting two early shots on goal, both of which were denied by Circle City fan-favorite Yago Darub.
Dothan’s Josh Salas would calm the opposing team down later on in the 21st minute of the match, zipping a shot past the Legion goalkeeper to put the Dragons on the board first.
Just seconds before the 26th minute, Rodrigo Lopes would get in on the action with another Dothan United goal thanks to an assist from Tiago Campos.
Defensively, the Dragons could do no wrong; no matter how many shots on goal Birmingham took, Darub was there to deny them.
Despite a first-half injury scare from Darub, he would hang tough, going on to finish the match.
A first-half goal from Campos in stoppage time, as well as Lopes’ second score of the night thanks to an assist from Dothan native Alec Palanjian, would spell the end for Dothan’s opponents.
The Dragons would go on to cruise to a 4-0 victory, keeping their undefeated record as they sit at 5-0 on the season.
Dothan will be back in action on Saturday, May 30th, when they take on Columbus United FC in Rip Hewes Stadium.
